in_marathi.name: Ishvithansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishvithansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishvithansh is a name derived from Sanskrit words ‘Ish’ meaning God and ‘Vithan’ meaning Abode. This name signifies the divine abode of God.
